# Frozen legacy audio reference

These original wavelogik headers are copied unchanged from logisth v0.9.4.1,
commit df868d15d6ee8ed9b83b4de85e95f4811b73eada, under the repository MIT license.
They use the identical, unmodified vendored Signalsmith headers from Source/.
Compile this reference and the current renderer with the same platform/compiler,
then compare audio and voice counts in the LegacyAudioCompatibility CTest.
The reference is test-only and must not track current engine edits.
